summary: Implemented the file-read progress feature in rich/progress.py: a private _Reader class that wraps a binary file and advances a Progress task by bytes read (seek resets the task position), Progress.read(file, total=None, task_id=None, description="Reading...") accepting a path or file-like object (total required for file-like objects), and a module-level rich.progress.read context manager. Added a CHANGELOG.md entry. Nothing was run or tested, per instructions, and no tests were added. Nothing was committed.
